sample.task: Write a coherent, elaborate, descriptive and detailed screenplay/shooting script, for a very long comedic scene (the scene, its contents and the interactions within it should develop organically and realistically, despite the absurdity; all character dialogues in the scene should have quotidian, simple language that people would actually use in such a scenario, with no excessive flourishes; all character dialogues should employ the dialect and vernacular that accurately fit the characters' backgrounds) in a Comedy Drama TV Series. The scene includes two female Lebanese American college seniors (describe their appearance) who are friends, and they have an acrimonious argument that devolves into a tit-for-tat food fight. Among the various acts in the food fight where the two women smear and dump various food items on each other, it culminates with one of the women dumling labneh on the other woman's head. The two women should be the only characters in the scene. The food fight shouldn't be outrageously comical and overly slapstick, it should be a measured tit-for-tat.
sample.chosen:
INT. UNIVERSITY CAFETERIA - DAY

The cafeteria is bustling with students. We focus on two Lebanese American college seniors, LYDIA and SARAH, sitting at a corner table.

Lydia, a petite brunette with a pixie cut, is wearing a vintage floral dress and a pair of worn-out Converse sneakers. Sarah, taller and more athletic, sports a casual jumpsuit and a pair of trendy ankle boots.

LYDIA
(leaning back, smirking)
So, Sarah, heard you got a B- on your biochem midterm.

SARAH
(raising an eyebrow)
And you got an A-, Lydia. Congrats.

Lydia chuckles, but Sarah's eyes narrow.

SARAH
(leaning in)
But you know what they say, Lydia. A B- is just a grade away from an A.

Lydia's smirk fades. She leans back, crossing her arms.

LYDIA
(defensive)
Well, at least I don't have to rely on my dad's connections to get into med school.

Sarah's face turns red. She stands up abruptly, knocking her chair back.

SARAH
(angry)
That's it, Lydia!

Sarah grabs a container of hummus from her tray and hurls it at Lydia. Lydia ducks, and the hummus splatters on the wall behind her.

LYDIA
(laughing)
Oh, come on, Sarah!

Lydia grabs a handful of pita bread from her tray and throws it at Sarah. Sarah ducks, and the pita bread lands on the floor.

SARAH
(grinning)
You're going to have to do better than that, Lydia!

The food fight escalates, with both women throwing various food items at each other. Lydia smears baba ganoush on Sarah's face, and Sarah retaliates by dumping a cup of mint tea on Lydia's lap.

LYDIA
(laughing)
You're going to pay for that, Sarah!

Sarah grins, grabbing a container of labneh from her tray. She scoops a generous amount onto a spoon and hurls it at Lydia.

SARAH
(smirking)
Catch this, Lydia!

The labneh lands on Lydia's head, and both women burst into laughter. The food fight comes to a halt, and they sit back down at their table, covered in food.

LYDIA
(wiping her face)
You know, Sarah, I think we've both had enough.

SARAH
(nodding)
Agreed. But you're still going to pay for that labneh, Lydia.

They both laugh, and the scene fades out as they continue to clean themselves up.
sample.rejected:
FADE IN:

  EXT. COLLEGE CAMPUS - DAY

  A bustling college campus. Students are scattered around, some studying, others chatting. The sun is shining brightly.

  CUT TO:

  INT. COLLEGE CAFETERIA - DAY

  Two female Lebanese American college seniors, LINA (early 20s, petite, long dark hair, olive skin, bright eyes) and SALMA (early 20s, tall, athletic build, short curly hair, warm smile), sit at a table, their lunch trays in front of them.

  LINA
  (exasperated)
  Salma, I can't believe you forgot our final project presentation!

  SALMA
  (defensive)
  I'm sorry, okay? I've been swamped with my part-time job.

  LINA
  (sarcastic)
  Oh, I'm sure the world will end if you don't make a few extra bucks.

  SALMA
  (angry)
  That's not fair, Lin. You know I'm trying my best.

  LINA
  (rolling her eyes)
  Yeah, right. Just like you tried your best to remember our presentation.

  SALMA
  (standing up)
  You know what? I'm done with this. I can't keep up with your unrealistic expectations.

  LINA
  (standing up)
  Fine. I don't need you anyway.

  The two women glare at each other, tension thick in the air.

  SALMA
  (smirking)
  You know what? I challenge you to a food fight.

  LINA
  (laughing)
  You're on.

  The two women grab their trays and head towards the center of the cafeteria.

  EXT. COLLEGE CAMPUS - DAY

  The cafeteria is now a battlefield. Students are scattered around, some watching the food fight, others trying to avoid getting hit.

  LINA
  (throwing a french fry)
  First one to hit the other loses!

  SALMA
  (throwing a slice of pizza)
  You're on!

  The two women dodge and weave, throwing food at each other with precision and accuracy.

  LINA
  (throwing a spoonful of mashed potatoes)
  Take that!

  SALMA
  (throwing a handful of salad)
  Not bad, but not good enough.

  The food fight continues, with both women getting more and more creative with their food choices.

  LINA
  (throwing a scoop of ice cream)
  You're going down!

  SALMA
  (throwing a cupcake)
  We'll see about that.

  The two women are now covered in food, their faces red with exertion and laughter.

  LINA
  (panting)
  You know what? I'm sorry.

  SALMA
  (smiling)
  Me too.

  The two women embrace, their friendship stronger than ever.

  FADE OUT.

criteria.question: 剧本是否包含两位黎巴嫩裔美国大四女生的详细外貌描写？
对话是否使用简单、日常、真实的口语，并体现符合角色背景的黎巴嫩裔美国大学生方言或俚语？
场景发展是否从激烈的争吵自然过渡到食物大战，且互动具有现实逻辑而非机械转折？
食物大战的节奏是否呈现为克制的‘有来有往’（tit-for-tat），避免了过于夸张或滑稽的闹剧风格？
场景是否以其中一名女子将拉布尼（labneh）抹在另一名女子头上作为高潮或结尾动作？
整个场景中是否仅出现这两位女性角色，未引入任何第三方人物？
